title: Reading Between the Headlines
text:
Headlines are designed to capture attention within seconds, and their wording often carries more persuasion than information. A verb such as 'slams' or 'admits' can signal a judgement before any evidence has been presented. Discourse analysts therefore examine not only what a text says, but how its choice of words positions the reader.

Readers, in turn, rarely notice these framing devices, since they absorb the implied stance without questioning it. Media literacy involves making such assumptions visible, by asking who is speaking, what is left unstated and why a particular vocabulary was selected. The aim is not cynicism towards all news, but a more deliberate reading of the language that shapes public opinion.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what can a verb such as 'slams' signal?
options: A neutral description of a meeting
A judgement before any evidence has been presented
A confirmed fact from official records

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what do readers rarely do with framing devices?
options: They translate them into other languages
They absorb the implied stance without questioning it

questions.text: Why do discourse analysts examine how a text's words are chosen?
options: Because word choice has no effect on readers
Because it reveals how the text positions its reader
Because they want to count the number of headlines

questions.text: What does the passage suggest about the aim of media literacy?
options: To reject all news as unreliable
To make assumptions in language visible and read more deliberately
To replace headlines with official statements

vocabulary.definition: the act of making someone agree through argument or emotional appeal
the way information is presented to shape how it is understood
suggested or hinted at without being stated directly
a general distrust of people's motives and sincerity

paragraph_translations: Заголовки створюють так, щоб привернути увагу за лічені секунди, і їхнє формулювання часто несе більше переконання, ніж інформації. Таке дієслово, як «slams» або «admits», може сигналізувати оцінку ще до того, як представлено будь-які докази. Тому дискурс-аналітики вивчають не лише те, що каже текст, а й те, як його вибір слів позиціонує читача.

Читачі, своєю чергою, рідко помічають ці засоби рамкування, адже сприймають прихований погляд, не ставлячи його під сумнів. Медіаграмотність полягає в тому, щоб зробити такі припущення видимими, запитуючи, хто говорить, що залишено недомовленим і чому обрано саме таку лексику. Мета не полягає в цинізмі щодо всіх новин, а в свідомішому читанні мови, яка формує громадську думку.
